name: Suijaku Sakusen 2 Moeyo Dragon
original_name: 衰弱作戦2　もえよどらごん
source:
Main character Rie-chan is a master of karate. This summer an evil shadow surrounds a quiet town. Rie finds herself in the middle a mysterious incident.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
